MRNA.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $1.31B, up 29%, well above ~$0.89B expected, driven by international COVID deliveries
First profit in years: net income $162M, EPS $0.38
2026 revenue growth guidance raised to 15-25%; year-end cash now $8.1-8.3B after a ~$3B convertible note
Cancer vaccine with Merck positive in Phase 3 melanoma (42% lower risk); norovirus Phase 3 interim missed early-success bar
Flu/COVID combo approved in Canada and EU, awaiting FDA guidance to refile; Analyst Day Nov 12

PFE.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $16.6B, flat; non-COVID products +7%, newer products +32%
2026 guidance raised to $62-64B revenue, adjusted EPS $2.95-3.05
Elrexfio Phase 3 positive; Litfulo vitiligo Phase 3 positive; Talzenna and Tukysa label expansions approved
COVID sales falling (Paxlovid -63%, Comirnaty -30%); $3.8B write-down on sigvotatug vedotin
2027 guidance expected mid-December

ABBV.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $17.4B, up ~10%; adjusted EPS $3.82, above expectations
2026 revenue guidance raised to ~$67.8B
Skyrizi $5.8B (+23%) and Rinvoq $2.7B (+24%) more than offset Humira's decline
Juvmo (Parkinson's) and Skyrizi SC induction approved; etentamig filed; Epkinly 1st-line lymphoma positive
Dividend raised 5.2%; 2027 guidance on the Q4 call

CRSP.title: Q3 2026 business update
points: Casgevy sales $99M (+30% vs Q2); 750+ patients have started treatment; FDA approved for ages 2+
Cash $2.28B; net loss $111M
CTX310 cholesterol/triglyceride edit got RMAT status; Phase 1b data at AHA Nov 9
Zugo-cel scleroderma data at ACR Nov 8; CTX611 Phase 2 readout 2H 2026
New CFO (A.J. Silver) and CTO appointed

LLY.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $24.4B, up 39%; volume +53%, prices -15%
Mounjaro $10.7B (+65%) and Zepbound $5.4B (+49%); Foundayo pill $184M
2026 revenue guidance raised to $91-92B (from $85-87B)
Approvals: Mounjaro heart-risk label, weekly insulin Onswik, Inluriyo for breast cancer, Jaypirca 1st-line CLL
Retatrutide filing planned Q1 2027; EloraTZP Phase 3 starts Q4 2026

NVO.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Sales DKK 79.2B, up 4% at constant currency; adjusted operating profit up 27%
Wegovy pill about $813M in the quarter, over 4x Lilly's Foundayo
Ozempic (-5%) and Wegovy injection (-2%) slipping in DKK
$1.4B impairments, including $0.7B on ziltivekimab; 2026 outlook -2% to +2%
CagriSema FDA decision expected by year-end, US launch early 2027; Mim8 positive EU opinion

JNJ.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Sales $25.4B, up 6%; drug business (Innovative Medicine) up about 8% to $16.8B
2026 guidance raised to about $100.7B in sales; adjusted EPS $11.05-11.15
Darzalex $4.2B (+15%), Tremfya about $2.4B (+68%), Caplyta passed $1B so far this year
Icotyde (psoriasis pill) launched March 2026; Rybrevant under-the-skin approval for head and neck cancer expected by year-end
$5.5B ovarian talc settlement charge; bought Firefly Bio for $1B; medical devices missed expectations

MRK.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $18.1B, up 5%; adjusted EPS $2.49, ahead of forecasts
2026 revenue guidance narrowed to $66.8-67.3B and EPS outlook raised
Keytruda $8.6B (+6%), including $830M from the under-the-skin Keytruda Qlex; patents start expiring in 2028
Gardasil about $2B (+14%) and Winrevair $694M (+94%)
About $550M of sales came from customers buying early, so next quarter may give some back; agreed to buy Silence Therapeutics for about $1.3B

BMY.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $13.1B, up 7%; newer 'growth' drugs up 12% to $7.7B
2026 revenue guidance raised to $49.75-50.25B, but EPS guidance cut to $6.35-6.55 after $1.56B of deal-related R&D charges
Eliquis $4.7B (+25%); Opdivo $2.4B (-6%); Revlimid and Pomalyst falling fast to generics
Positive Phase 3 results for iza-bren (breast and lung cancer), admilparant (lung scarring) and RYZ101 (neuroendocrine tumors)
Milvexian heart-rhythm (AF) results due Q1 2027; Europe Eliquis generics expected to cut $1.5-2B of sales in 2027

AMGN.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $10.4B, up 8%; 17 products grew double digits
2026 guidance $38.9-39.7B revenue, non-GAAP EPS $22.90-23.70
Repatha $1.1B (+37%), Tezspire $538M (+43%), Uplizna $451M (+191%), Imdelltra $406M (+128%)
Prolia (-45%) and Xgeva (-47%) hit by biosimilars; FDA asked Amgen to withdraw Tavneos in the US (Amgen requested a hearing)
MariTide obesity Phase 3 program enrolling, no efficacy results yet; Tezspire positive Phase 3 in eosinophilic esophagitis

GILD.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $8.3B, up about 7%
2026 product sales guidance raised to $31.0-31.3B; EPS guidance moved to a loss after $12.4B of deal-related R&D charges (Arcellx, Tubulis, Ouro, PepStar)
Biktarvy $4.1B (+10%), Descovy $1.0B (+49%), Yeztugo PrEP shot $305M (about $1B expected this year), Trodelvy $506M (+42%)
Bixlenvo (bictegravir + lenacapavir) approved; Trodelvy approved for first-line triple-negative breast cancer
FDA decisions due: anito-cel (myeloma) Dec 23, 2026 and once-weekly oral lenacapavir Feb 2027; Medicare price cut on Biktarvy from 2028

VRTX.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $3.44B, up 12%; 2026 guidance raised to $13.15-13.25B
Journavx pain pill $58M (750,000+ prescriptions in the quarter); Casgevy $99M
Closed the roughly $10B Crinetics acquisition on Sept 1
Povetacicept (IgA kidney disease) FDA decision due Nov 30, 2026
Dropped zimislecel (type 1 diabetes cells) in favor of VX-017; inaxaplin kidney data early 2027

REGN.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $5.1B, up 36%; non-GAAP EPS $20.07, up 70%
Dupixent $6.5B global sales (+35%, booked by Sanofi); Regeneron's profit share $2.6B
Eylea HD US $699M (+62%) while older Eylea fell 41%; Libtayo $550M (+51%)
Expanded Sanofi deal: $1.0B up front, up to $7.0B in milestones
Pasatru approved for FOP in Aug; FDA decisions due on cemdisiran (Nov 2026) and odronextamab (Feb 2027)

BIIB.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $2.8B, up 11%; newer products up 49% to $1.26B, helped by Apellis drugs bought in May
Non-GAAP EPS $2.62, down 46%, due to about $284M of deal charges (mainly RayThera)
Leqembi in-market sales $202M (+67%); Skyclarys +34%; Spinraza +23%
Older MS drugs keep shrinking: Tecfidera -51%, Vumerity -11%
Lupus Phase 3 results for litifilimab due first half of December 2026

ZTS.title: Q3 2026 results (animal health)
points: Revenue $2.39B, roughly flat; adjusted EPS $1.75 beat forecasts
US pet medicines fell 8% on generic and dermatology competition; livestock +7%
2026 adjusted EPS guidance raised to $6.25-6.35; revenue narrowed to $9.22-9.32B
$89M write-down tied to PetMedix research
Convenia ready-to-use approved for dogs in October; some approvals pulled forward to Q4 2026

VTRS.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $3.75B, flat; adjusted EPS $0.71 (+6%)
Guidance midpoints raised: revenue $14.7-14.9B, adjusted EPS $2.56-2.63
Nashik (India) plant stopped after FDA findings, costing about $100M of sales in Q3 and Q4 each; restart expected Q1 2027
New products: Ryzumvi eye drops approved for presbyopia (Oct), Gwyn Lo contraceptive patch launched
Agreed to buy Pacira BioSciences for about $1.65B, expected to close by end of November

INCY.title: Q3 2026 results
points: Revenue $1.56B, up 14%; 2026 sales guidance raised to $5.21-5.30B
Jakafi $827M (+4%); Opzelura $255M (+36%); Zynyz +157%
One-time $1.23B R&D charge for buying Vega Therapeutics
Povorcitinib (hidradenitis) got a positive EU opinion; US approval expected Q1 2027
Phase 3 results due by year-end: povorcitinib in prurigo nodularis and Opzelura in hidradenitis
